paite: Huan nang mihing tapa, Israel tangte kiang ah thu gen inla, "Nou Israel tangte aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia un. Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi:
heading: Israel Tung A Pathian Vualzawlna
english: You, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, “You mountains of Israel, hear Yahweh’s word.

paite: Na tung ah na melmate'n, 'Aha! Nidang mun sang tengtengte kei a ahita, achih ziak un,' " thu gen in.
english: The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because the enemy has said against you, “Aha!” and, “The ancient high places are ours in possession!”’

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Nam omsunte a ding a kil chih a nang ahon nek ua, hon sukgawp ziak un leh mikamtamte houlimna leh gensiat a ahon omsak ziak un;
english: therefore prophesy, and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because, even because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that you might be a possession to the residue of the nations, and you are taken up in the lips of talkers, and the evil report of the people;”

paite: Nou Israel tangte aw, Toupa PATHIAN thu ngaikhia un, Toupa PATHIAN in tangte, mualte, luiguamte, phaizangte leh mun sesate, khopi kigawpsa, akim a nam omsunte samat lel ding leh nuihsan dingte kiang ah hichi in achi.
english: therefore, you mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Yahweh: The Lord Yahweh says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken, which have become a prey and derision to the residue of the nations that are all around;

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Nam omsun leh Edom tengteng lungsim kipaktak a ka gam na na kiseh tawm ua; na hon musit mahmah ua, gallak a bawl mite tung ah ka mullitna thangpaih mahmahna in thu ka gen ngei ahi.
english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Surely in the fire of my jealousy I have spoken against the residue of the nations, and against all Edom, that have appointed my land to themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart, with despite of soul, to cast it out for a prey.”’

paite: Huaiziak in Israel gam tungthu ah thu gen inla, tangte, mualte, luiguamte leh phaizangte kiang ah Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai un, namdangte simmohna na thuak ziak un mullit mahmah leh thangpaitak in thu ka gen ahi.
english: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and tell the mountains, the hills, the watercourses and the valleys, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my wrath, because you have borne the shame of the nations.”

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Na kim a namte'n amau zahlakna apo ngei ding uh chi in ka khut ka zak hi.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “I have sworn, ‘Surely the nations that are around you will bear their shame.’

paite: Nou bel, Aw Israel tangte aw, hiang na suah ding ua, ka mi Israelte a ding in gah na suah ding uh; ahong pai dek uhi.
english: “‘“But you, mountains of Israel, you shall shoot out your branches and yield your fruit to my people Israel; for they are at hand to come.

paite: Ngai un, nou lam a pang ka hi ngal a, nou lam ka nga ding a, kalhnen in na om ding ua, chi tuh in na om lai ding uh.
english: For, behold, I am for you, and I will come to you, and you will be tilled and sown.

paite: Na tung uah mihing ka pungsak ding a, Israel inkote tengteng, avek un; mun sesate bawlphat in a-om ding a, khopite luah in a-om ding.
english: I will multiply men on you, all the house of Israel, even all of it. The cities will be inhabited and the waste places will be built.

paite: Na tung uah mi leh sa ka pungsak ding a, apung un alamzang ding uh; na omdan masa bang in luah in ka hon omsak ding a, atung a na omdan sang ua hoihzaw in ka hon bawl ding hi; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
english: I will multiply man and animal on you. They will increase and be fruitful. I will cause you to be inhabited as you were before, and you will do better than at your beginnings. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

paite: Ahi, na tung uah mi ka vaksak ding a, ka mi Israelte ngei; ahon luah ding ua, agoutan uh na hi ding a, tuban siah atate uh na tansak ngei nawn kei ding hi.
english: Yes, I will cause men to walk on you, even my people Israel. They will possess you, and you will be their inheritance, and you will never again bereave them of their children.”

paite: Hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi: "Nang mihingte nemang, na mite tansek na hi, ahon chih ziak un,
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because they say to you, ‘You are a devourer of men, and have been a bereaver of your nation;’

paite: mihingte na ne bei nawnta kei ding a, na mite leng na tan ngei na hon sam kei ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: therefore you shall devour men no more, and not bereave your nation any more,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Pau tuam mite muhsitna ka hon thuaksak nawn kei ding a, mite gensiat na thuak ngei nawn kei ding; na mite na tan ngei nawn kei ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in,” achi hi.
english: “I won’t let you hear the shame of the nations any more. You won’t bear the reproach of the peoples any more, and you won’t cause your nation to stumble any more,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
heading: Israel Hinkho Thak
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israel inkote amau gam a aten lai un a-omdan uleh athilhihte un akihihnin ua; ka ma a a-omdan uh numei kizen louh lai a asianthoulouhna bang mai ahi.
english: “Son of man, when the house of Israel lived in their own land, they defiled it by their ways and by their deeds. Their way before me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.

paite: Huaiziak in gam tung ah sisan asuah ua, amilimte ua akihihnit ziak un atung uah ka hehna ka lungdamsak hi.
english: Therefore I poured out my wrath on them for the blood which they had poured out on the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols.

paite: Namte lak ah ka dalhsak a, gam chih ah athehthangta ua; a-omdan uleh athilhihte uh bang zel in atungthu uh ka gensak hi.
english: I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries. I judged them according to their way and according to their deeds.

paite: Ava hohna namte kiang atun un ka min siangthou ahihbuah ua; mite'n, 'Hiaite TOUPA mite ahi ua, gam a kipan hong pawtkhete ahi uh," "ana chih nakna uah.
english: When they came to the nations where they went, they profaned my holy name, in that men said of them, ‘These are Yahweh’s people, and have left his land.’

paite: Himahleh Israel inkote'n ava hohna namte lak a ahihbuah uh, ka min siangthou ka lainat ahi.
english: But I had respect for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they went.

paite: Huaiziak in Israel inkote kiang ah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Aw, Israel inkote, noute ka hon lainat ziak hilou in, na va hohna namte lak a na hihbuah uh, ka min siangthou ka lainat ziak zaw in hiai ka hih ahi.
english: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I don’t do this for your sake, house of Israel, but for my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you went.

paite: Ka min thupitak, namte lak a buah, alak ua noumau ngei in na hihbuah uh ka siangthousak ding ahi; huchi in amitmuh ua noute a hihsiangthou a ka om hun chiang in TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: I will sanctify my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, which you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am Yahweh,” says the Lord Yahweh, “when I am proven holy in you before their eyes.

paite: Namte lak a kipan ka hon pikhe ding a, gam tengteng a kipan ka hon kaikhawm ding a, na gam mahmah uah ka hon pilut ding hi.
english: “‘“For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your own land.

paite: Huan na tung uah tui siang ka theh ding a, na hong siangthou ding ua, na nitna tengteng uleh na milimte lak ua kipan ka hon khuahsiang ding.
english: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from all your idols.

paite: Lungtang thak ka hon pe ding a, na sung uah kha thak ka koih ding; na taksa ua kipan suang bang a sak lungtang ka lamang ding a, taksa bang a nip lungtang ka hon pe zaw ding hi.
english: I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.

paite: Na sung uah ka kha ka koih ding a, ka dan bawl ah ka hon vaksak ding a, ka thupiakte na kem ding ua, na zui ding uh.
english: I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes. You will keep my ordinances and do them.

paite: Na pipute uh kiang a ka piak gam ah na teng ding uh; nou ka mite na hi ding ua, kei na Pathian uh ka hi ding.
english: You will dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers. You will be my people, and I will be your God.

paite: Na nitna tengteng ua kipan ka hon hunkhe ding a, buh-le-bal ka sam ding a ka hon pungsak ding, na tung uah kial ake nawn kei ding hi.
english: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and will multiply it, and lay no famine on you.

paite: Singgahte ka pungsak ding a, louma ka pungsak ding a, kial ziak in namte lak ah zahlakna na thuak kei ding uh.
english: I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the increase of the field, that you may receive no more the reproach of famine among the nations.

paite: Huchi in na omdan giloute uh, na thil hihhoihloute uh na theigige ding ua, na kihhuaina uleh na thulimlouhna uh ziak in noumau mitmuh mahmah in na kihta ding uhi.
english: “‘“Then you will remember your evil ways, and your deeds that were not good; and you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.

paite: Noute ziak a hiai hih ka hi kei chih na thei mai un, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi. Aw, Israel inkote aw, na omdan ziak un zum unla, lamdang sa un.
english: I don’t do this for your sake,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Let it be known to you. Be ashamed and confounded for your ways, house of Israel.”

paite: Na thulimlouhna tengteng ua kipan ka hon khuahsiang ni chiang in, khopite ka hon luahsak nawn ding a, mun sesa ka bawl nawn ding.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited and the waste places will be built.

paite: Huchi in gam sesa, tuma lam a mi vialvakte mitmuh a sesa nung himahleh lei leh in a-om ding hi.
english: The land that was desolate will be tilled instead of being a desolation in the sight of all who passed by.

paite: Hiai gam sesa nung Eden huan bang mai ahong hi nawnta, achi ding uh; khopi sia a, na kigawpsate luah leh um in a-om nawn ding hi.
english: They will say, ‘This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden. The waste, desolate, and ruined cities are fortified and inhabited.’

paite: Huan na kim ua nam omlaite'n kei TOUPA'N mun siate ka bawl nawn a, gam na se khinsa ka hihhoih nawnta chih athei ding uh; kei TOUPA ka pauta a, ka hih ngei ding hi.
english: Then the nations that are left around you will know that I, Yahweh, have built the ruined places and planted that which was desolate. I, Yahweh, have spoken it, and I will do it.”

paite: Huan Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Huai lou in hiai Israel inkote ka hon dingsak ding a; ganhon bang mai a amite uh hihpung ding in.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “For this, moreover, I will be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will increase them with men like a flock.

paite: Kithoihna ding ganhon, a-ankuanglui sehsa a Jerusalem ganhonte bang mai in; huchibang in khopi sesa nung mipi tampi in ahong dim ding ua; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh," achi hi.
english: As the flock for sacrifice, as the flock of Jerusalem in her appointed feasts, so the waste cities will be filled with flocks of men. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”
